summary: pastor_leader is a Home-screen persona plus one external deep-link. On Home, sectionOrder (persona-config.ts:432-442) renders in this order: greeting → hero_audio/scripture (with a PASTOR_CHAPTERS rotating fallback when no plan/slots exist) → plan_scripture (either the multi-step PastorStudyOnboarding wizard first-run, or "Today's Study" plan cards with a Greek/Hebrew toggle on return) → pastoral_prompt ("Between You & God" reflection card, journaling or Bible-AI hand-off) → commentary (expanded) → ai_prompt (Bible AI gets 4 extra "For your message" quick prompts) → campus_count (rendered as a real-analytics Campus Overview gated on a pastor/campus code, not fake numbers) → book_cards. The dedicated "Preach" card that used to open in-app sermon prep now, as of 9 Sep 2026, immediately navigates the pastor off the PWA to the external Pastors Sermon Prep app (PREP_URL); the in-app PreachScreen/SermonWorkspace files remain in the repo but are dead code, unmounted from App.tsx. Completion/streak stamping is entirely generic (recordStreakToday, idempotent per day) — no pastor-specific completion logic exists. StudySourcesCard (in Settings/More) lists attribution for the study data layer (netlify/functions/study.js via src/utils/study.ts) that backs the pastor's prep tools.
